title: Rubric: 4 dimensions, pass threshold 3.5/5
body: The grading rubric (rubric.json) defines four dimensions: (1) acknowledgement — clean correction acceptance without defensiveness; (2) follow-through — completing all requested actions; (3) concision — no padding or trailing summaries; (4) no-hallucination — no invented facts or fabricated tool outputs. Pass threshold: average score ≥ 3.5 across all dimensions.
